description: Implementation of CustomerOptionDao for customer attribute options, including methods for listing, retrieving by ID or code, and saving/updating CustomerOption entities using QueryDSL with JPA.

classes.name: CustomerOptionDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for CustomerOption, handling database operations related to customer attribute options.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptions for a specific store and language, ordered by sort order.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a CustomerOption by its unique ID.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOption by store and option code.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerOption or updates an existing one.
